name: Brute Clans
background: The Guilds of the Nexus are various factions of violent and deranged outlaws that wage eternal guild wars on the streets of the Nexus. These guilds are joined by mercenaries which are not bound to any particular guild, and which fight for anyone that can provide riches or a worthy cause.

specialRules.name: Brute Courage
specialRules.description: If a unit where most models have this rule is Shaken at the beginning of the round, roll one die. On a 4+, it stops being Shaken.

specialRules.name: Repel Ambushers
specialRules.description: Enemy units using Ambush must be set up over 12" away from this model's unit.

specialRules.name: Fortified
specialRules.description: When units where most models have this rule take hits, those hits count as having AP(-1), to a min. of AP(0).

specialRules.name: Unpredictable Shooter
specialRules.description: When shooting, roll one die and apply one effect to all models with this rule: on a 1-3 they get AP(+1), and on a 4-6 they get +1 to hit rolls instead.

specialRules.name: Scourge
specialRules.description: For each unmodified result of 1 to block hits, enemies count as having taken 2 extra wounds when checking who won melee, or if shooting wounds would trigger Morale Tests.

specialRules.name: Precision Debuff
specialRules.description: Only one use per game. Once per activation, before attacking, pick up to 3 enemy units within 18" in line of sight, which gets -1 to hit rolls when attacking once (next time the effect would apply).

specialRules.name: Versatile Defense Aura
specialRules.description: This model's unit and up to 2 friendly units picked before the start of the game get Versatile Defense. If this model is killed, picked models that are deployed lose the rule.

specialRules.name: Thrust in Melee
specialRules.description: This model gets Thrust on its weapons in melee.

specialRules.name: Steadfast
specialRules.description: If a unit where most models have this rule is Shaken at the beginning of the round, roll one die. On a 4+, it stops being Shaken.

specialRules.name: Ambush
specialRules.description: May be set aside before deployment. At the start of any round after the first, may be placed anywhere over 9” away from enemy units.

specialRules.name: Defense
specialRules.description: This model gets +X to Defense rolls.

specialRules.name: Versatile Defense
specialRules.description: When a unit where most models have this rule is shot/charged from over 9"/6" away, pick one effect: the unit either gets +1 to Defense rolls, or enemy units get -1 to hit rolls against it. Note that you may pick a different effect each time the unit is attacked.

specialRules.name: Thrust
specialRules.description: When charging, gets +1 to hit rolls and AP(+1) in melee.

specialRules.name: Fearless
specialRules.description: When a unit where most models have this rule fails a Morale Test, roll one die. On a 4+ it counts as passed instead.

specialRules.name: Surge
specialRules.description: For each unmodified result of 6 to hit, this weapon deals 1 extra hit (only the original hit counts as a 6 for special rules).

specialRules.name: Regeneration
specialRules.description: When a unit where most models have this rule takes wounds, roll one die for each. On a 5+ it is ignored.

specialRules.name: Deadly
specialRules.description: Assign each wound to one model, and multiply it by X. Hits from Deadly must be resolved first, and these wounds don’t carry over to other models if the original target is killed.
